architecture: Partition-specific frozen multitask directed-bond representations followed by task-specific GPU boosting; matched structure/assay control
graph_source: v27 checkpoint_5500; concatenate seed embeddings, never average unaligned latent coordinates
selection: Freeze positive historical-valid shortlist, then evaluate partition-specific scaffold CV. CV utility combines full fold gain and ring/acyclic gain weighted by label-free test ring fraction. Official valid utility is downweighted when its ring fraction differs strongly from test, or it contains one scaffold. CV remains a historical proxy. Eligible positive domain-CV, bounded valid decline and positive combined utility. Individual tasks/folds may decline.
representation_labels: Only source checkpoint fit labels. Every queried target scaffold and nonisomeric identity excluded globally from supervised representation learning in valid and CV.
limitations: Historical validation and folds repeatedly reused; selection bias. CV comparator is a historical proxy, not complete ensemble OOF. Other task assay summaries are conditional official features. Ring adjustment uses no test labels and is a coarse domain proxy. Official total score formula unknown; no guaranteed gain.
